about_short_description.short_description: Levers helps B2B companies in reducing overdue payments, accelerate cash collection, and boost cashflow.

product.name: Levers B2B Receivables Collection Platform
product.description: A platform that automates and manages B2B receivables collection by integrating ERP, email, payment gateways, and bank accounts to accelerate cash flow and reduce manual tasks.

product.name: AI Phone Call Collection
product.description: An AI-driven system that makes human-like phone calls to customers for payment reminders, dispute resolution, and negotiation, following company policies and handling objections.

product.name: Automated Payment Follow-ups
product.description: A service that automates sending personalized payment reminders and follow-ups across multiple communication channels to reduce manual collection efforts.

product.name: Bank Reconciliation Automation
product.description: Automatically matches and reconciles incoming bank transactions with outstanding invoices to update financial records and flag discrepancies in real-time.

product.name: Contract to Invoice Automation
product.description: AI-powered tool that scans contracts, extracts billing details, and generates compliant invoices ready for sending, reducing manual invoice preparation.

product.name: Customer Risk Assessment and Monitoring
product.description: Automatically assesses customer credit risk using bank data and payment behavior to recommend payment terms and monitor risk continuously post-onboarding.
